Dwivedi ... Pet V/s. The State of Maharashtra (at the instance of Health Ministry of Govt. of Maharashtra) & Ors, ... Res _______________________________________ Mr. Balwant Salunkhe for the Petitioner Ms. Neha S. Bhide, G.P. with Mr. O.A. Chandurkar, Addl.G.P. with Ms. G.R. Raghuwanshi, Agp for Respondent Nos. 1 to 6 _______________________________________ Coram : Alok Aradhe, Cj. And Sandeep V. Marne, J. Date : 05 August 2025 P.C. : 1.
texts.arguments: In this Petition, filed as Public Interest Litigation, the Petitioner inter alia seeks a direction to the Respondents for strict implementation of ban on gutkha and pan masala and other chewable tobacco products which are banned by the State of Maharashtra. 2. The learned Addl. Govt. Pleader, on instructions, submits that the State Government, in exercise of powers under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules and Regulations made therein, has issued a Notification on 16 July 2025 banning the usage of gutkha and pan masala.
